mechanism: Venlafaxine inhibits norepinephrine reuptake, and systemic absorption of ophthalmic timolol (a non-selective beta-blocker) may result in additive effects on cardiovascular function and potential serotonin-norepinephrine interaction.
action: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate; ensure timolol instillation technique minimizes systemic absorption via nasolacrimal occlusion; consider alternative ophthalmic agent if cardiovascular effects emerge.
